source.note: Generated from v1 by a script kept outside the repo; see README.md in this folder.

mappings: v1 parse result `{ ok: true, model }` -> `{ kind: "ok" }`; `{ ok: false, kind, message }` -> `{ kind, message }`.
Model field `dirExplicit` -> `isDirExplicit` (op args use the port names).

Op args are written in the port's signatures; the generator maps them to v1's positional arguments (updateAttr(g, classId, index, patch), addRelation(g, from, to, kindId), addNote(g, text, forId, ns), ...).
Ops returning `{ model, id }` are compared on the model; `expected` is the serialized code after the step.
Text is measured at 7px per character (v1's DOM-free fallback = approximateTextWidth in the port).
Layout positions are top-left corners rounded to 2 decimals; `l` is the note text tag. Place cases start from v1's dagre layout of the previous code (rounded), stored in `start`.
